text:
ying (NorthBridge): hi team — NorthBridge wants to run a 4-week co-sell pilot. Need a sandbox tenant, SAML SSO, BYOK for keys, and a short pricing/commit quote for ~2M tokens/month. Also: can your telemetry export to our Datadog account?
maya: flagged. We can do sandbox + SSO. BYOK/HSM depends on deployment mode (Private or Dedicated supports BYOK). We'll need the partner's KMS details.
sam: For telemetry -> we can forward traces/logs to a customer datadog org via an outbound webhook or set up a push integration. Question: do they want raw request bodies? (we usually mask PII).
ying (NorthBridge): They want full traces without request bodies; payloads should be scrubbed for PII. Also need GDPR residency in eu-west for customer data.
mona: Security quick list: 1) SOC2 Type II copy 2) DPA/DSA signed 3) BYOK / HSM support confirmation 4) data retention and deletion API 5) pen-test report (last 12 months). Pilot can proceed with SOC2 snapshot and DPA signed.
rolf: Ops note: We'll provision a Dedicated sandbox in eu-west-1 with a small GPU pool. For 2M tokens/month, suggest a committed monthly node for cost predictability. I'll draft a commit vs on-demand comparison.
ying (NorthBridge): Also we need rate-limiting by seat/license (NorthBridge will gate 3rd party partners). Can you support token/quota labels per API key?
sam: Yep — we can provision per-api-key quotas and entitlements. We'll need to sync the partner's license ids so we can map them.
maya: Pricing: rough hosted estimate (no commit) vs dedicated commit. I'll run numbers and post a formal quote by Friday. If they want the best latency, Dedicated commit will lower unit cost.
rolf: Networking: they require IP allowlist for callbacks and inbound tests. Provide the dev/test IP ranges and we'll set static egress for callbacks. Also, do they need mutual TLS for webhooks?
ying (NorthBridge): mTLS preferred but not mandatory for pilot. We'll try plain TLS first. Dev IPs: 203.0.113.0/25.
mona: BYOK specifics: do they want FIPS 140-2 HSM or cloud KMS? If they mandate HSM-backed key wrapping we need Private with HSM appliance or a partner HSM. For Dedicated we can support customer-managed KMS (CMEK) but not on-host HSM.
rolf: I'd add: if they insist on on-prem HSM, we can do Private deployment with a gateway to their HSM. That will add onboarding lead time (~3 weeks).
ying (NorthBridge): Pilot timeline is tight — prefer not to wait 3 weeks. Can you support envelope encryption using their KMS (CMEK) in eu-west Dedicated?
maya: Yes, we can. We'll document CMEK steps for the partner.
sam: Smoke test plan (I'll run once tenant is up): 1) healthcheck 2) sample chat flow with latency measurement 3) embeddings vector upsert/retrieve 4) telemetry forwarding check. Sample curl for chat test:
```
curl -s -X POST 'https://staging-eu.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat' \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>' \\
  -H 'X-Trace-Id: nb-pilot-123' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-chat","input":"hello"}'
```
rolf: I'll create the tenant and a trial API key. ETA: Tue 10am UTC if partner confirms SAML metadata by EOD Mon.
ying (NorthBridge): Uploading SAML metadata now: https://northbridge-files.example/saml-metadata.xml  Also attaching signed DPA: https://northbridge-files.example/dpa-signed.pdf
mona: I'll review the DPA and confirm any redlines. For pilot we accept the signed DPA as-is for the sandbox.
maya: Enablement: we can do a 45m run-through with SRE + product next Wed. We'll cover runbook, smoke tests, telemetry, and escalation path.
ying (NorthBridge): Good. Can you also include a short slide on rollback strategy and throttling behavior? Their procurement wants to understand worst-case costs.
maya: Sure — we'll include cost guardrails, throttles (per-key QPS), and a kill-switch.
sam: One blocker: partner asks for synchronous 200ms p95 for small chat. In eu-west with quantized variant and small context we expect ~300-400ms. We can set a canary in a nearby region to try for 200ms but can't guarantee. Noted in runbook.
ying (NorthBridge): Pilot acceptance criteria: 1) p95 chat latency <500ms, 2) embeddings recall >90% on test set, 3) telemetry forwarded to Datadog.
rolf: Noted. Next actions: Rolf -> tenant + trial keys (Tue), Sam -> smoke tests + telemetry hook (Wed), Mona -> security checklist & DPA review (Mon), Maya -> formal quote + enablement invite (Fri). Ying -> confirm NDA + provide license ids (today).
ying (NorthBridge): NDA signed and sent (uploaded): https://northbridge-files.example/nda-signed.pdf  License ids: NB-ENT-2026-A, NB-ENT-2026-B.
infra-bot: Deployment job queued for tenant "northbridge-sandbox-eu" (job id q-87234). Status: pending.
rolf: I'll follow up once the sandbox is live. Thanks all.
maya: I'll drop the quote in this thread by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
